title: Curl Chemist
subtitle: An autonomous AI agent that detects chemical conflicts in hair products and builds personalized routines.
description: A background autonomous agent that goes beyond standard chatbots. It leverages Google Gemini to orchestrate tools, analyze weather conditions, detect chemical conflicts in product ingredients, and schedule personalized hair care routines.
whatToExpect: Autonomous ReAct Agent: AI pipeline using Gemini API for reasoning and Gemma for prompt injection guardrails.
Chemical Conflict Engine: Detects issues like glycerin usage in high humidity based on ingredient lists.
Automated Workflows: Triggered daily by Cloud Scheduler to fetch weather data and update routines.
Zero-Trust API: Secure FastAPI backend with JWT validation and OIDC token verification.
Cloud Infrastructure: Serverless backend built on Google Cloud Run, Firestore, and automated with Cloud Build.

title: Atlas of Stories
subtitle: A literary map app that brings the stories of your favorite books to life through real-world locations.
description: An interactive mapping application where users can search for a book and see every place connected to it, complete with trivia, quotes, and the story behind each location.
whatToExpect: Interactive Map: Navigate literary locations globally using MapLibre GL.
Book Search: Search for a book to explore where its story happens.
Location Details: Discover trivia, quotes, and the stories behind the places.
AI Integration: Leverages Google GenAI to extract and enrich location-based literary content.
Cloud Infrastructure: Containerized with Docker, deployed on Google Cloud Run, and provisioned via Terraform.

title: Dostoevsky Tribute
subtitle: A tribute website for the great Russian author Fyodor Dostoevsky.
description: This website is a tribute to the life and works of the renowned Russian writer Fyodor Dostoevsky. It was created as a learning project to explore the usage of Three.js for 3D modeling, CSS animations, and to express admiration for Dostoevsky's literary contributions.
whatToExpect: Index Page: Contains a brief biography of Fyodor Dostoevsky.
Works Page: Displays a 3D model of a bookshelf using Three.js. Clicking on a book opens a flipbook with details about the selected book.
Timeline Page: Presents a chronological timeline of significant events in Dostoevsky's life.
Characters Page: Features flip cards showcasing some of Dostoevsky's most important characters, discussing their symbolism and relevance.
Quotes Page: Includes a collection of memorable quotes by Dostoevsky. Quotes are clickable for easy copying.

title: Egypt Wonders
subtitle: Explore the breathtaking treasures of Egypt through a curated travel guide filled with wonder and inspiration.
description: An immersive travel guide to Egypt featuring 101 must-see places, hotel recommendations, and user personalization features.
whatToExpect: 101 Wonders: Discover detailed descriptions, images, history, prices, and hours for top locations in Egypt.
Hotels Section: Browse 80 luxurious hotels across 7 cities with interior/exterior previews, pricing, and more.
User Accounts: Sign up, log in, and save your favorite places for easy access.
City Quotes: Each city features an inspiring quote to set the tone of your journey.
Modern UI: Responsive and intuitive interface for both locals and travelers.

title: This Portfolio (Recursion Edition)
subtitle: Showcasing my portfolio... inside my portfolio. Is this recursion or just narcissism?
description: A 3D interactive portfolio built with React, Three.js, and CSS, featuring a floating laptop, glass panels, and a desktop simulation to showcase my projects in a creative way.
whatToExpect: 3D Laptop Model: Clickable and interactive, opens a simulated desktop UI.
Project Desktop: Each project is displayed as a desktop shortcut with a windowed preview.
Panels: About, Contact, DevOps, and more, all in a glassmorphic floating UI.
Mobile Responsive: Looks great on any device.
Futuristic Design: Neon, glass, and a Windows-inspired vibe.
